pulses.name: Supply Chain Poisoning via PyPI Repository Compromise
pulses.description: Xinference, an open-source distributed AI model inference framework, suffered a supply chain attack when attackers compromised PyPI release credentials of maintainers and published three malicious versions (2.6.0, 2.6.1, 2.6.2) on April 22, 2026. The malicious code, encoded in Base64 layers within __init__.py, executes automatically upon library installation or import, collecting cloud credentials
